messages:
ci-bot: [CI] hosted-integ suite failed on git main — job #4823. Tests: auth_integration.test_token_refresh, streaming_integ.test_stream_chunk_loss, toolcall_integ.test_tool_invocation_schema. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/4823 :warning:

maya: Ugh. Saw that. @jon can you grab bisect? It looks new after yesterday's runtime patch.

jon: On it. Quick note: failures look correlated with `token_cache` changes in runtime. Running local rerun now.

qe-jen: I can repro streaming failure intermittently locally with `--race` enabled. Logs show `EOF while reading` during websocket handshake.

alex: If it's auth + streaming + toolcall, could be a shared header change (trace id or auth header formatting). @maya did the header wrapper PR land yesterday?

maya: Yes merged: https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo/pull/7245 — it normalizes `x-rw-req-id` and moves auth into `Authorization` consistently.

jon: Bisect result: top suspect commit 6f3a8d2 (runtime: token cache v2). I'll open a rollback PR for quick test: `revert: 6f3a8d2`

maya: Before rollback, can someone try a focused rerun with env `FEATURE_TOKEN_CACHE=v1`? We might avoid rollback.

sahil: I kicked a rerun: ci -> rerun job 4823 with overrides env. watch: https://ci.redwood.internal/4823/retry

maya: QE logs after rerun attached: ```ERROR: Auth error: malformed header 'Authorization' at runtime/header.go:47
stream: websocket: close 1006 (abnormal)
toolcall: schema validation failed: missing 'tool_name' field``` Looks like header normalization dropped prefix for some clients.

alex: I think the header lib strips `Bearer ` prefix when migrating. Quick patch submitted to keep prefix in header parsing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo/pull/7260 Tagging @jon for review.

jon: Reviewing now. If patch works, we can hotfix on hosted for Canary. Also suggest adding integration test that asserts Authorization header preserves `Bearer ` prefix.

maya: Agreed. QE can add a small test. @qe-jen can you add and push test so we don't regress? :thumbsup: 

qe-jen: Adding test now. Will push in ~20m and queue CI.

ci-bot: [CI] rerun started (job 4823-retry-1). I'll post results on completion.
